Feed readiness

Source registry

Projection policy

Official FPL is canonical for prices, positions, IDs, fixtures, and scoring. First-party Premier League and club announcements confirm transfers. No betting odds are used.

Account boundary

No password is stored and no account action is performed automatically.

Recommendations only. Evidence is locally stored with source provenance.
